state.paragraph: Party E (a strategic buyer) submitted an LOI to acquire the Company for a price of $21.26 per share (subject to a 60-day exclusivity period for due diligence and negotiation of definitive documentation).

ledger_rows.Note: New strategic buyer approached management unsolicited, expressing interest in acquiring the Company; late entrant during the LOI stage.
Signed after its approach and before its 07/12 IOI; then received the memorandum. It may not be counted in the filing's 25-NDA total.
IOI; equity value $108M. Made before data-site access (Heavy by context).
Catch-up access for late entrant: Party C got data-site access and a telephone management presentation (07/14); the seven others had in-person presentations.
Non-binding LOI with mark-ups of the merger and voting agreements (Formal by markup); subject to expedited diligence review. Highest LOI.
LOI asking for a 60-day exclusivity period for diligence and documentation. Sent an issues list on the merger and voting agreements, not a markup, so recorded Informal.
LOI with mark-ups of the merger and voting agreements; four-week diligence period.
LOI; 30-day diligence period; no markup reported. Below its $21.00 IOI (#21).
LOI; 30-day due diligence period; no markup reported.
One of the seven IOI bidders advanced in #17; chose not to submit an LOI; never mentioned again.
One of the seven IOI bidders advanced in #17; chose not to submit an LOI; never mentioned again.

$20.02 cash + $1.13 CVR tied to sale of South Quay property (payment form not stated). Asked for a three-week exclusive diligence period. Marked up merger agreement, voting agreement and disclosure letter. Arrived after 07/20 due date.
Revised after GHF said its price and CVR structure were not competitive: $21.02 cash + $1.13 CVR. Diligence terms not restated; assumed unchanged from #31.
Committee chose confirmatory diligence and negotiations with G&W and Party B for their higher offers. Dated 07/27: meetings were 07/22 and 07/27, and the choice relied on G&W's 07/26 revision (#32).
GHF later told the remaining bidders they were out; sorted to the Committee's decision day. $19.30 LOI.
GHF later told the remaining bidders they were out; sorted to the Committee's decision day. $21.00 LOI.
GHF later told the remaining bidders they were out; sorted to the Committee's decision day. $21.26 LOI.
GHF later told the remaining bidders they were out; sorted to the Committee's decision day. $19.20 LOI. F later gave Party E financing support (#41) but did not bid again.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

exclusivity.instructions: `paragraph` reports that exclusivity is requested, authorised, granted, signed or extended. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
